At Wyze, we make smart home technology accessible to everyone. We're known for disrupting markets with high-quality, affordable products - from cameras to lighting to sensors and more. We believe technology should simplify life, not complicate it. We’re a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team driven by curiosity and powered by data.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Product Manager to drive the day-to-day product experience for the Wyze Scale product line, from requirements through launch and post-launch iteration. This is a cross-functional role at the intersection of connected hardware, mobile experiences, data, and customer trust. You’ll work closely with Product leadership, who set the overall direction, and own the execution and continuous improvement of the core scale experience.
What You’ll Do
Contribute to the Wyze Scale vision, strategy, and prioritized roadmap in partnership with Product leadership, grounded in customer needs, market insights, business goals, and technical feasibility.
Drive the customer experience across setup, measurements, insights, and ongoing use, working with hardware, firmware, mobile app, support, and lifecycle communications partners.
Conduct customer research and synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals to identify high-impact problems, validate opportunities, and recommend clear trade-offs.
Translate product priorities into requirements, user stories, success metrics, and launch plans for engineering, design, operations, quality, marketing, and customer support partners.
Partner with hardware, firmware, mobile, cloud, data, and design teams to deliver reliable, intuitive, high-quality connected-device experiences.
Coordinate cross-functional launch planning for new products and features, including pricing and packaging input, positioning, launch readiness, inventory and operational considerations, customer education, and support preparedness.
Track and report on product health metrics, including activation, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, quality, and returns, and use the results to prioritize post-launch improvements.
Present product updates, recommendations, risks, and trade-offs clearly in cross-functional and leadership reviews.
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a closely related technical field.
2-3 years of product management experience.
Experience owning or contributing to a consumer product or feature from discovery through launch and post-launch iteration.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize, build roadmaps, and drive execution across multiple functions with guidance from leadership.
Experience working closely with engineering and design teams to ship customer-facing products.
Customer research, analytical, and decision-making skills, with a track record of using data and customer insight to guide prioritization.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain trade-offs simply and build alignment with stakeholders.
Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, with a strong sense of ownership.
Bonus Points
Master’s degree in engineering, business, product management, or a closely related field.
Experience with connected hardware, consumer electronics, IoT, wearables, fitness, wellness, or health-adjacent products.
Experience building mobile app experiences and integrating hardware, firmware, cloud services, and third-party platforms.
Familiarity with measurement accuracy, data quality, privacy, and customer trust considerations in health-adjacent experiences.
Experience with direct-to-consumer launches, e-commerce, subscriptions, or retail channels.
Experience defining analytics instrumentation and using product data to improve engagement and retention.
Success Looks Like
Roadmap and priorities: A customer-informed Wyze Scale roadmap, developed with Product leadership, that clarifies where to invest and why, supported by strong working relationships across hardware, software, design, operations, marketing, and support.
Customer journey and launches: Steady improvement to the journey from purchase through setup, measurement, insight, and continued use, with launches that have product, operational, marketing, and support readiness built in early.
Measurable outcomes: Demonstrated gains in activation, engagement, retention, satisfaction, and quality.
Base Salary $140,000-156,000 DOE + bonus target up to 20% + equity
Compensation
The base pay range for this role is $140,000 – $156,000 per year.
More About Us
Over the years, Wyze earned a reputation for disrupting entrenched categories and delivering products that feel almost too good to be true. That early impact brought industry recognition from Forbes, TIME, Fast Company, PCMag, and others… all signals of momentum that helped establish Wyze as a breakout brand.
Today, Wyze is focused on its next stage of company building. We’re scaling our platform, strengthening our operating rigor, and investing for long-term growth, while staying true to the belief that everyday people deserve access to great technology. This is a phase defined less by headlines and more by execution, craft, and durable impact.
Our people are central to that work. Wyze has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built in Seattle and Seattle Business Magazine, but what matters most is the environment we’re building now: one where smart, pragmatic builders take ownership, move fast, and shape what comes next.
Come Join Us!
Benefits
Wyze has a full benefits package through Premera Blue Cross. This includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life Insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, EAP, Short-term disability, Long-term disability, FSA, and Daycare FSA. Depending on the benefits package you choose, a portion of the employee and dependent premiums will be covered by Wyze.
12 Holidays - 8 set holidays and 4 Floating Holidays
24 days of PTO every year
Additional Wyze anniversary vacation days
Principal 401k Plan (no company match at this time)
Wyze is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable participation in the job application or interview process, performance of essential job functions, and access to other benefits and privileges of employment, in accordance with applicable law.
If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact recruiting@wyze.com.

Wyze hears from customers every day across Support, social channels, and communities - but turning those conversations into reliable, quantified insights that teams can act on takes a deliberate, data-driven approach. Use AI and data analysis to synthesize customer support and feedback signals, identify recurring pain points, quantify their scale and impact, and communicate actionable insights.

Lead business reviews with stakeholders across Wyze, presenting customer experience trends, operational performance, emerging risks, and recommendations.
Define, maintain, and evolve customer support metrics and goals, ensuring teams have clear, useful measures of performance and customer outcomes.
Identify and drive process improvements that reduce customer friction and strengthen support operations.
Take direct ownership of operational processes as needed, improving how they work and tracking the results.

5+ years of experience owning and delivering programs, initiatives, or operational improvements in customer service, customer support, or customer experience.
Demonstrated hands-on fluency with AI-enabled tools and data analysis; able to analyze customer feedback and operational data, validate findings, and quantify trends and their impact.
Experience defining, building and using customer support metrics, dashboards, or reporting to guide decisions and measure outcomes.
Experience analyzing support interactions and feedback from channels such as surveys, social, or communities to identify recurring issue drivers and quantify customer impact.
A track record of partnering with cross-functional stakeholders - including Product, Engineering, Data, and customer-facing teams - and turning customer insights into clear recommendations and action.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex customer and operational findings clear to both technical and non-technical audiences.
